subject: Nimbus Health — invoice breakdown, platform fee amortization & SOW request
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@nimbushealth.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 17:12:00 +00:00
Subject: Initial: invoice breakdown, platform fee amortize options for VPC/on-prem

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this. Procurement at Nimbus is starting to gather the documentation we need to onboard Redwood for a VPC/on-prem deployment. Before we get our PO and legal teams involved, can you provide a clear invoice structure and a sample of how the platform fee and support charges would be billed? Specifically: 

- Can the platform fee be amortized over 12/24/36 months (sample amortized invoice)?
- Do you offer commitment-based discounts vs metered (no commit) pricing? Rough % ranges are fine at this stage.
- Support tiers (Standard / Premier / Enterprise) — what are the response windows and included oncall hours?
- Any one-time migration credits or onboarding fees we should expect?
- Example invoice for a 20-GPU footprint and an EU data residency add-on.

We'd appreciate a spreadsheet we can feed into our finance system. Attached a short internal template that shows how we prefer line items.

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Head of Procurement
Nimbus Health

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. Quick acknowledgement: we can produce an amortized invoice and a commitment vs metered comparison. 

Two quick clarifying asks before we generate everything:
- Is the 20 GPUs steady-state (reserved) or an expected peak with burst?
- Do you require SOC 2 + EU residency as a hard requirement at contract signature?

I'll loop in Vivek (account lead) for commercial framing and Laura (sales ops) for invoice formatting. Can we schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow so we can walk through two clean options and a sample SOW?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Success — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: invoice breakdown, platform fee amortize options for VPC/on-prem

Oliver / Mina,

Thanks — happy to outline commercial options. High level (estimates provided to align with procurement):

Option 1 — 24m Commit (recommended for predictability)
- Platform fee: one-time platform entitlement amortized over 24 months (we can invoice monthly).
- Discount: up to 22% off metered GPU runtime if you commit to a 24m reserved pool for 20 GPUs.
- Support: Premier included with commit (24/7 oncall, 1-hour P1 response, named CSM, 8x5 engineering support).
- Migration credit: one-time credit to offset the first 3 months of runtime for migrations up to $30k.

Option 2 — Metered (no commit)
- Platform fee: higher monthly platform fee (non-amortized).
- Discount: none on runtime; metered rates apply.
- Support: Standard (8x5, 4-hour P1) included; upgrade to Premier/Enterprise as add-on.

Other notes:
- EU data residency is supported; there is a small regional surcharge (line item) to cover EU-hosted control plane.
- We can provide a sample amortized invoice (line items for platform entitlement, runtime, support, EU add-on).

Attached a short commercial summary and a mock invoice that shows amortization. If these high-level numbers look reasonable, we'll draft a short SOW and a sample invoice for Nimbus's finance team.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Commercial_Summary_Nimbus.pdf
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@nimbushealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com, mina_haddad@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:22:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Initial: invoice breakdown, platform fee amortize options for VPC/on-prem

Thanks Vivek — that framing helps. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- The 20 GPUs are expected steady-state (we intend to reserve capacity).
- SOC 2 is required for go-live; EU residency is mandatory.
- Could the platform entitlement be capped if amortized? Procurement prefers a not-to-exceed platform fee (so any overage is capped and described as a one-time change).
- We prefer amortization over 24 months. Can you show the monthly amortized line item and the total not-to-exceed amount?
- What does the Premier support oncall look like in practice (weekend coverage, escalation path to engineering)? We need details for our SLA appendix.

If you can provide an amortized sample invoice and a draft SOW we can share with legal and finance, we can move quickly.

Oliver Grant
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Health
From: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: invoice breakdown, platform fee amortize options for VPC/on-prem

Oliver — attached are four items: (1) an amortized invoice for a 24-month schedule, (2) a Line-by-Line pricing table exported as CSV, (3) a short commercial summary with support tier SLAs, and (4) a draft SOW outline. Highlights below: 

- Amortized platform entitlement: we show a not-to-exceed total of EUR 240,000 amortized to EUR 10,000/month over 24 months (line item: "Platform Entitlement — 24m amortized").
- Runtime (20-GPU reserved pool): shown as committed rate, monthly runtime estimate included as separate line items; committed runtime discount applied at 20%.
- EU residency: separate monthly surcharge EUR 1,200.
- Support tiers (quick):
  - Standard: 8x5 business hours, P1 4-hour response, access to community docs.
  - Premier: 24/7 oncall with named CSM, P1 1-hour response, engineering escalation during business hours, weekend escalation for P1s.
  - Enterprise: include on-prem engineer rotation and quarterly on-site review.
- Migration credit: one-time credit applied to month 1 invoice up to EUR 25k.

Attachment: Invoice_Sample_Nimbus_202611.pdf, Redwood_VPC_Pricing_Table_v1.xlsx, Draft_SOW_Nimbus_202611.docx

Link to HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HS-9832

If the amortized cap and SLA bullets look okay, we can convert the draft SOW into a fully executable doc and provide PO instructions (exportable invoice PDF + accounting codes).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sales Operations Manager

1) Final SOW reflecting the migration credit (EUR 25k) and the EU residency controls.
2) An amortized invoice PDF (monthly lines) and a not-to-exceed statement for the platform entitlement (EUR 240,000).
3) PO instructions and the billing contact for Redwood (invoice email + AP code).

If you can send the executable SOW and the sample invoice, we will push to our legal and finance next week. Requested PO target: Nov 30, 2026.

Thanks — Oliver Grant
